links.outcome: Radiologist adjudication of label-report discordance between CT-RATE labels and GPT-5.4 labels
links.effect: Adjudication supported GPT-5.4-derived labels in 72 of 97 (74.2%) general discordant instances and 91 of 99 (91.9%) targeted lymphadenopathy discordant instances; overall agreement 96.4%, kappa 0.884.
links.quote: In discordance review, radiologist adjudication supported GPT-5.4-derived labels in 72 of 97 (74.2%) general discordant instances and 91 of 99 (91.9%) targeted lymphadenopathy discordant instances.

unlisted_practices: LLM-assisted cleaning of report-derived labels in public imaging datasets
multi-LLM majority-vote labeling to improve label quality

screen.reason: Evaluates using LLMs for automated label cleaning/extraction on a large retrospective dataset of radiology reports, with radiologist adjudication of discordances, but does not test a clinical deployment guardrail or practice.
